meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 当你问关于当前代码库的问题时，Claude 会先检查项目里有没有知识图谱文件；若没有，会提示你先运行 /understand。若有，则检索图谱中与问题相关的代码节点、依赖关系和架构分层，并联系具体文件和函数来回答。
howto.when: 当你需要询问当前代码库的问题，或想借助知识图谱理解代码时，向 Claude 提问即可触发。

say.text: 这个项目主要用什么语言和框架？
say.note: 它会读取图谱中的项目元数据。

say.text: order.py 里定义了哪些函数？
say.note: 它会找文件节点，并列出其关联的函数节点。

say.text: 支付流程会用到哪些类或文件？
say.note: 它沿图谱中调用和依赖边追踪相关实现。

howto.what_en: When asked about the current codebase, Claude first checks whether the knowledge graph file exists; if absent, it prompts to run /understand. If present, it searches nodes, dependency edges and layers, then answers by citing specific files and functions.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user asks about the current codebase or wants to understand code using the knowledge graph.

say_en.text: What languages and frameworks does this project use?
say_en.note: It reads the project metadata from the graph.

say_en.text: What functions are defined in order.py?
say_en.note: It finds the file node and its related function nodes.

say_en.text: Which classes or files are involved in the payment flow?
say_en.note: It follows call and dependency edges in the graph.
